**Provisional tie-break stop-only counterfactual, NOT two-reviewer consensus:** 1 SEND (4349), 35 NONE of 36; 35/36 = **97.2% candidate-output false positives under these provisional labels** if all 36 stop texts would have been sent. Oracle limits: the executable fixture pins accounting, precedence and suppression of a **classified** routine candidate. It cannot infer containment or owner intent from raw prose, cannot force the model to call `Classify`, and cannot attest to the existing overseer's live behavior until rebuilt/activated and observed. Untagged text is deliberately not hard-suppressed at the daemon boundary: an opaque keyword filter risks swallowing a fresh safety event or owner answer.
